svg.title: What starts the bots
svg.desc: Renovate, the updates of Dependabot, the release bot and the branch bot merge as the release app, and a person as themselves, since a merge with the token of a workflow would start no workflow. So every merge into main is a push, which starts the release bot and the branch bot at once; they keep the release pull request current and bring the next pull request up to date. Only an event that GitHub lost waits for the schedules, a few runs a day, which GitHub runs as it can, often hours late, and every night the bot-health bot starts a workflow whose schedule GitHub missed.
